The suite passes again (17 tests). The cause was in `tax()` in `invoicing/pricing.py`. It computed tax on the full subtotal, although its docstring and the tests say tax applies after the discount. I changed it to use the subtotal minus the discount.

For the failing case, 200.00 with PARTNER25 now gives 150.00 after discount. UK tax is then 30.00 and the total is 180.00. Before the fix it gave 40.00 tax and a total of 190.00.

I didn't touch any tests. `git` isn't installed here, so I couldn't look at yesterday's merge to confirm it caused this.

CLAIM: done
